priorityList: Always maintain Combo Strikes by never casting the same ability twice in a row.
Invoke Xuen the White Tiger when Zenith is available or active to maximize burst synergy.
Cast Zenith when Xuen is active, during Bloodlust, or when Rising Sun Kick is on cooldown.
Use Celestial Conduit during Zenith windows when Rising Sun Kick, Fists of Fury, and Strike of the Windlord are on cooldown.
Cast Whirling Dragon Punch on cooldown, especially during Zenith or when Xuen is on cooldown.
Use Fists of Fury when at 30 stacks of Flurry Charge or during Heart of the Jade Serpent and Bloodlust windows.
Cast Rushing Wind Kick on cooldown.
Cast Strike of the Windlord on cooldown, prioritizing its use during Zenith windows.
Cast Rising Sun Kick on cooldown as your primary Chi spender.
Use Spinning Crane Kick when Dance of Chi-Ji is active or to consume Sequenced Strikes procs.
Use Blackout Kick with Combo Breaker procs or to spend Chi when near the maximum cap.
Use Tiger Palm to generate Chi if you have less than 4 Chi and are about to cap Energy.
Use Touch of Death on cooldown, unless Zenith is currently active.
Use Slicing Winds as a filler if all other rotational abilities are on cooldown.
Use offensive Racials, Potions, and Trinkets in alignment with Xuen and Zenith windows.
